name: testimonial-slider

frames.best_why: Quote, avatar, name and both arrows are all crisp and settled, unlike the crossfade frames.

tagline: Quotes fade and swap around a round photo, with arrows on either side.
summary: A single large testimonial on a dark panel: a circular avatar under a soft halo, a bold quote and a name with role. It rotates to the next quote on a timer, or by the round arrow buttons.
appearance: One testimonial fills a wide dark slate panel. At the top a small round portrait sits inside a faint radial halo, then a bold white quote over two or three lines, and under it a name and job title in italic. Round arrow buttons sit at the left and right edges.
behaviour: Every few seconds the current quote and portrait fade out and the next slides in on a light rotate, with a brief crossfade between the two. Clicking the round arrows jumps forward or back, pauses the timer and later resumes it.
demo_content: Three short quotes from Alice Johnson, Bob Martinez and Carol Liu at fictional companies.
search_phrases: single quote with next and previous arrows
social proof block for a landing page
reviews that change on a timer
use_when: A landing or pricing page that needs one strong customer quote at a time without a wall of cards.
avoid_when: Auto-rotates every few seconds, so a slow reader may lose the quote, and it relies on remote avatar images.
customise: Pass an array of testimonials with image, quote, name and role, plus autoRotate, duration and className; transition curves are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A few stacked nodes crossfading with CSS transitions and a timer; no canvas or loop.

a11y.note: Prev and next buttons have aria-labels, but the auto-rotation keeps changing the quote with no pause control and no reduced-motion check.

issues: During the crossfade both quotes overlap and become briefly unreadable.
polish_why: Clean centered layout; the quote crossfade overlaps text and looks muddy mid-swap.
title: Testimonial Slider
